notes.title: Actor reveal for Cabernet! Sam Retford from Ackley Bridge & Thing-in-Itself
notes.content:
Today, we are thrilled to introduce the voice actor behind Cabernet's Ivan: Sam Retford.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27212213/be9173dc1c97872c52979c0a82f357b0db790d54.jpg[/img]

Sam Retford, an actor of Australian-English descent, gained recognition for his portrayal of Cory Wilson in the Channel 4 drama series Ackley Bridge. Beyond his work on stage, he has also graced television screens in shows like Casualty and Death in Paradise as well as playing the role of Ted in our own debut game, Thing-in-Itself.

In Cabernet, Sam plays Ivan, the charismatic leader of a revolutionary group. Ivan is determined to bring change, but at what cost?

We're delighted to welcome Sam to our team and are eagerly anticipating the upcoming announcements about the cast.

notes.title: Wishlist Cabernet on Steam now!
notes.content:
After several years of work, we are so happy to announce our first full-length supernatural narrative RPG, Cabernet! 🦇 🩸 

We can't wait to hear your thoughts. And of course, don't forget to wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2401410/Cabernet/

[b]Change is brewing, threatening the established ways of alluring supernatural aristocrats. Sustain your facade as one of the living and struggle with your morality as a young vampire. Will you retain your humanity or descend further into the horror you have become?[/b]

Cabernet is a 2D narrative RPG set in 19th century Eastern Europe. Guide Liza, a young vampire struggling with her morality and the supernatural world she has been pulled into. Beware, the taste of Cabernet is not for the faint of heart - prepare to explore themes of social conflict, alcoholism, and corruption.

notes.title: "A Lozenge" is out now!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1354100/A_Lozenge/

Hi all! Thank you so much for following us on our dev journey,

We are super excited to finally say that ​​"A Lozenge" is now released on Steam.

We've put a lot of heart in this game and really hope you enjoy it. Please let us know your thoughts in the comments on the game page - we'd love to hear from you!

[previewyoutube=6pU3o5SivFc;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Michelle is nauseous every car trip. A ginger lozenge may make her feel a little better, but this morning that’s a lot of pressure for a hard candy.[/i]

​“A Lozenge” is a short interactive story about motion sickness, dedicated to children of divorce. In the format of a 10-minute visual novel, it lets the player join Lucy and Michelle on their mother-daughter road trip.​

They will play as Lucy, a newly separated mother of a 9-year old, Michelle. They will hear Lucy’s thoughts, feel her doubts and anxieties and help her comfort her daughter by making occasional dialogue choices.​

“A Lozenge” is the third in Party for Introverts’ anthology of emotion-driven interactive short stories, along with “Thing-in-Itself” and “From Head to Toe”.

notes.title: "From Head to Toe" is coming out July 20th, 2019
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27212213/6c6f47873c96ab3de3e31994931e53a0d356089f.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone,

We wanted to announce the upcoming release of our new project  [b]"From Head to Toe".[/b]

It is coming to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1104890/From_Head_to_Toe/]Steam[/url] and [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.PartyForIntroverts.FromHeadToToe]Google Play[/url] on July 20th, 2019 and will be free.

It is a short interactive story about winter, existential guilt and your ex-classmates.

In this experimental 2D game, you play as Betty—a young woman visiting her hometown. Joined by her high school best friend, Quentin, Betty journeys to her childhood home on a path that she has walked so many times before.

The two of us have been working on it for quite some time and a lot of heart went into it.

Let us know what you think, we can't wait for you to try it.

For more updates you can follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/PIntroverts]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://facebook.com/PIntroverts]Facebook[/url].

notes.title: Thing-in-Itself is now available on Mac
notes.content:
